assets.name: lecture_09_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: This is the clearest and most complete diagrammatic frame in the set. It shows the reader with an open book, a small story-world figure emerging from the pages, and a contrasting background of people engaged with the outside world. That makes the lecture's point visually legible: a reader may understand the internal world of the book as well as, or better than, the world beyond it.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: and sometimes just as well or even better than the reader understands the world outside of the book.
